title: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment.
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment.
I stand quietly near the tent entrance… careful not to be seen.
Sarah holds the child she once believed she would never have. Abraham’s voice breaks into joyful laughter—years of waiting suddenly collapsing into one unforgettable moment.

The promise that seemed impossible…
is now wrapped in linen and resting in her arms.
And standing nearby, hidden in the shadows, I realize something beautiful: when God fulfills a promise, He doesn’t just answer prayers… He turns doubt into joy.
The impossible becomes a story of celebration.
And I can’t help but wonder…
What promise in your life might still be waiting for its moment of laughter?
